appDesc.message: Capture a full-page screenshot by scrolling to the bottom and stitching the slices together.

needPermMsg.message: This page has a cross-origin iframe. Grant access to capture it.

errBlocked.message: Can't capture this page (script injection blocked).

resCopyHint.message: Copy the image to the clipboard — then paste it anywhere (Ctrl/Cmd+V)

edSplitNote.message: Editing isn't available for split (oversized) captures — download the parts below.

hintSelect.message: Select, move, resize or delete an annotation. Double-click text to edit it.

hintCrop.message: Drag to choose a region, then click Apply to crop the image.

hintArrow.message: Drag to draw an arrow pointing at something.

hintRect.message: Drag to draw a rectangle outline around an area.

hintText.message: Click where you want text, then type. Enter confirms.

hintPencil.message: Draw freehand to circle or scribble.

hintBlur.message: Drag over sensitive values to hide them (pixelate / redact).

optChromeManages.message: Chrome manages shortcuts on its own page.

optFormatHint.message: JPEG produces much smaller files on long pages.

optOversizedHint.message: Beyond the canvas limit: keep full resolution or fit one image.

optCaptureDelayHint.message: Increase for pages with heavy lazy-loading or canvas rendering (e.g. Google Docs).

optStabilize.message: Wait until the page stops changing

optStabilizeHint.message: Slower, but more reliable for canvas apps (e.g. Google Docs): recaptures each step until it settles.

optAutoDownloadHint.message: Save the file automatically when the result opens.

optPermHint.message: Capturing content inside cross-origin iframes (e.g. design previews) needs broad host access. Grant it only if you need that.
